specs: No third-party service or API key
pros: The highest-return fix on a WooCommerce store
No monthly subscription, unlike the SaaS equivalents
Customer data never leaves your site

products.forWho: Anyone running a WooCommerce store with meaningful traffic. If you are losing carts, this pays for itself faster than anything else here.

products.summary: Countdown timers, low-stock alerts, recently-sold counts and live viewer counts — with every number pulled from your actual store data rather than invented. Cache-safe and no API keys required.

One-time price rather than an annual licence

Use it dishonestly and it will cost you trust — the honest mode is the point

Needs sensible trigger settings to be worth having

guide.heading: What buying one of these is actually like
guide.intro: These are our own plugins, so here is the unglamorous version of what happens after you pay — including the parts that are on us to fix.

points.p: You pay once and the plugin is yours. There is no annual licence, no seat count and no tier that unlocks the useful features later. That is the whole point of the range: the job these do is normally sold as a monthly service, and a monthly service is what you are replacing.

points.h: It runs on your own site
points.p: There is no external account, no API key and no dashboard on someone else's server. Cart data, leads and view counts stay in your own WordPress database. That is better for privacy, better for page speed and it means nothing breaks if a third-party service changes its pricing.

points.h: Every number shown is a real one
points.p: The urgency widgets and the social proof badges are built so they cannot display invented numbers. If a product has not earned a "Popular this week" badge, no badge appears. Fabricated scarcity and fake review counts are not just tacky — in the UK they are a consumer law exposure.

points.h: WordPress and WooCommerce plugins are the mature ones
points.p: The eight plugins on this page are installed on real sites, including our own. We are honest that the source-code products in our store — the self-hosted SaaS templates — are a newer range built for developers rather than site owners, and they are a different kind of purchase.

points.h: You will need to configure them
points.p: None of these are install-and-forget. Abandoned Cart Recovery needs its email sequence wording checked against your brand, and Newsletter Capture needs its triggers tuned or it will annoy people. Budget half an hour each, and they will do their job properly.

points.h: If a download gives you trouble, tell us
points.p: These are digital downloads delivered after checkout. If a file will not open or a plugin will not install, email us and we will sort it directly rather than leaving you to fight a support queue. We would rather fix a problem than lose a customer over it.

proof.heading: Why buy these from us
proof.intro: We wrote these plugins and we use them on our own sites. That is a genuine advantage and an obvious bias, so we are telling you both plainly.

cards.p: These are installed on megastore76.com and on client sites. When something breaks, we are the ones who have to fix it, which tends to make for better plugins.
No external account, no API keys, no third-party dashboard. If you stop using a plugin, nothing of yours is stranded on someone else's server.
Our urgency and social proof plugins are built so they cannot show invented figures. We would rather a badge not appear than have it appear dishonestly.

faq.q: Is this really a one-time payment?
faq.a: Yes. You pay once and the plugin is yours, with no annual licence and no subscription. That is deliberate — the job each of these does is normally sold as a monthly service, and replacing that monthly bill is the reason the range exists.

As a download after checkout, installed on your own WordPress site like any other plugin. There is no external account to create and no API key to paste in. If a file will not open or a plugin will not install, email megaphilip76@gmail.com and we will sort it out directly.

Abandoned Cart Recovery and Urgency & Scarcity are WooCommerce-only and will do nothing on a non-store site. The other six — Newsletter Capture, Social Proof Badges, Reading Experience Kit, Smart Search, Live Chat and Social Pulse — work on any WordPress site.

faq.q: Which one should I buy first?
faq.a: Abandoned Cart Recovery, if you run a WooCommerce store with real traffic. Losing carts usually costs more than anything else on a store, and recovering them is the highest-return fix available. If you are not running a store, start with Smart Search at £19 or Social Proof Badges at £24.

faq.q: Do the urgency and social proof widgets show fake numbers?
faq.a: No, and they are built so they cannot. Every countdown, stock level, viewer count and badge is pulled from your own store or view data. If a product has not genuinely earned a "Popular this week" badge, no badge is shown. Invented scarcity is a consumer law risk in the UK, not just a bad look.

faq.q: Do I need to know how to code?
faq.a: No. These install and configure from the WordPress admin. Smart Search takes about two minutes with no setup at all. The ones with more options — Abandoned Cart Recovery and Newsletter Capture — need their email wording and triggers tuned, which is form-filling rather than coding.

faq.q: What about the source-code products on your store?
faq.a: Those are a separate, newer range — self-hosted SaaS templates like Invoice Chaser and Shiplog, sold as source code for developers at £29 to £99. They are a different kind of purchase from these plugins and we would rather say so than blur the two together.

finalVerdict.heading: Which one, depending on your site
finalVerdict.intro: Find your situation and buy that one. If none of them fit, message us and we will say so rather than sell you something you will not use.
